$comment: The single source of the package layer map. Each entry is one layer, L0 first. A package may import @plainworks packages only from a strictly lower layer. After editing, run `bun run sync-layer-map` to regenerate the docs.

layers.summary: Errors, results, guards, resilience, shared seams, list contracts, and structural web types. No React.
Reactive state, typed HTTP, the design-token substrate, and logging/error-reporting/Web Vitals seams.
Streaming, RPC, TanStack Query integration, and vendored UI atoms.
Authentication, OIDC with PKCE, forms, data, navigation, and UI composites.
Application composition, shared test tooling, reusable MSW mock-building primitives, and the development-only runtime inspector.
